gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the details of a specific usage trigger by providing its SID so that I can understand its current configuration and status.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the details of the specified usage trigger, including its SID, account SID, friendly name, and the threshold value.

gold.user: As a user, I need to update an existing usage trigger's threshold value so that it reflects my new usage monitoring requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated threshold value and return a confirmation message along with the updated trigger details.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to delete a specific usage trigger that is no longer needed to keep my account organized and prevent unnecessary alerts.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the usage trigger and return a success message.

gold.user: As a product manager, I want to create a new usage trigger with a specific threshold so that I can monitor usage effectively and receive alerts when limits are approached.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the new trigger details and return the SID of the created trigger along with its configuration.

gold.user: As a user, I want to list all usage triggers associated with my account to review their configurations and statuses.
gold.ideal: The API should return an array of usage triggers, each containing its SID, friendly name, and threshold value, allowing me to see all triggers at a glance.
